data.name: Necromantic Focus
data.description: The cabalist gains Spell Focus (necromancy) as a bonus feat. He also adds additional spells to his spellbook from the following list, provided he can cast spells of the appropriate level: 1st-cause fear, 2nd-blindness/deafness, 3rd-bestow curse, 4th-poison, 5th-feast on fear (ACG), 6th-slay living.
